title: docs(pm-dispatch): one patrol routine per seat, not per project

_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiHXKqxUqDPJKZyNHP7BoqTb)_

Fixes #28699
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:pm-dispatch `SKILL.md` 第 72 行把项目席巡查 routine 的单位从「每项目一个」改成「每席一个」,其余一字不动,净行数 0。
- 为什么改:`SKILL.md` 与 `seat-lifecycle.md`、`project-forms.md` 自相矛盾;一个项目坐多条车道时,实际做法是每个席位线程各绑一个巡查,因为每席是各自的会话。
- 风险与回滚:只改规则文字,无代码;不改的风险是读者照旧句只给项目建一个巡查,其它席位醒不来。回滚 = revert 本 commit。
- 先看:`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 第 72 行(唯一改动)。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -n 每项目一个 -- .claude/skills` 预期零命中,`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` 预期绿。
- 需要你做的:用授权账号批准本 PR(受管面上的规则改动),随后由席位落地。

## What changes

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` line 72, the project-seat wake line, now names the seat as the unit of the self-bound patrol routine: 「每项目一个」 becomes 「每席一个」. The director-seat exception and the rest of the line are unchanged. `SKILL.md` stays at 319 lines (net 0).

This matches the references on `main` after #28687: `references/seat-lifecycle.md` (taking a seat creates the routine and records `Patrol:` on that seat's stub) and `references/project-forms.md` (「坐席即建巡查 routine」, one seat thread per seat).

## Tests

No code changed, so there are no unit tests. Verification is the gate families derived from the diff (below).

## Acceptance notes

- Wording: the card asks for "one routine per seat thread". 「每席位线程一个」 would put the line at 124 bytes, over the 120-byte cap that `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` enforces. 「每席一个」 is 115 bytes and reads unambiguously, because the line before it defines a project seat as a project thread (「会话是车队项目的线程」). It also matches `project-forms.md`'s 「每席开一条席位线程」.
- No other file restates this unit: `git grep -n 每项目一个` exits 1 on this head (control: `git grep -n 自建自绑巡查` finds line 72).
- Governed surface (`.claude/**`): this PR stays draft and waits for its tier's record.
